description: Source code for managing persistent storage of NEL policies and reporting endpoints/groups in SQLite, including schema creation, migration, and batch operation handling.

classes.name: SQLitePersistentReportingAndNelStore::Backend
classes.description: Backend class managing SQLite database operations for NEL policies and reporting endpoints/groups, including schema creation, migration, batching, and commit logic.

classes.name: PendingOperation
classes.description: Template class representing a pending database operation (add, update, delete) for a specific data type.

classes.name: NelPolicyInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a NEL policy for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a reporting endpoint for database storage.

classes.name: ReportingEndpointGroupInfo
classes.description: Struct holding serialized information about a reporting endpoint group for database storage.

methods.name: LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Loads NEL policies from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: AddNelPolicy
methods.description: Adds a new NEL policy to the database queue.

methods.name: UpdateNelPolicyAccessTime
methods.description: Updates the last access time of a NEL policy.

methods.name: DeleteNelPolicy
methods.description: Deletes a NEL policy from the database.

methods.name: LoadReportingClients
methods.description: Loads reporting endpoints and groups from the database asynchronously.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Queues addition of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: AddReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Queues addition of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupAccessTime
methods.description: Updates last access time for a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: UpdateReportingEndpointGroupDetails
methods.description: Updates details of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: DeleteReportingEndpoint
methods.description: Queues deletion of a reporting endpoint.

methods.name: DeleteReportingEndpointGroup
methods.description: Queues deletion of a reporting endpoint group.

methods.name: DoCommit
methods.description: Commits all queued database operations within a transaction.

methods.name: CreateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Creates the initial database schema for version 2.

methods.name: DoMigrateDatabaseSchema
methods.description: Handles migration from schema version 1 to 2.
